# Meghalaya Tourism

> > Official tourism guide to Meghalaya, India's 'Land of Clouds,' showcasing the Khasi, Jaintia, and Garo Hills with their living root bridges, waterfalls, tribal culture, and unique matrilineal heritage.

Meghalaya Tourism provides comprehensive travel information for exploring Northeast India's hill state, featuring destinations like Shillong, Cherrapunji (Sohra), Mawlynnong, and Dawki. The site highlights cultural experiences, adventure activities, traditional handicrafts, and suggested itineraries across the three main tribal regions.

## Key Topics

- Khasi Hills
- Garo Hills
- Jaintia Hills
- Shillong
- Cherrapunji (Sohra)
- Mawlynnong
- Tribal culture (Khasi, Jaintia, Garo)
- Matrilineal heritage
- Living root bridges
- Traditional handicrafts and textiles
- Bamboo and cane crafts
- Tura Peak
- Laitlum Canyon
- Dawki River
- Cultural heritage sites

## Explore Destinations

- [Explore Meghalaya](https://meghalayatourism.in/explore): Main exploration hub for Khasi, Jaintia & Garo Hills destinations
- [Jowai - Jaintia Hills](https://meghalayatourism.in/explore/destinations/main-towns/jowai): Jowai town guide in Jaintia Hills with cultural & historical sites

## Travel Planning & Itineraries

- [Suggested Itineraries](https://meghalayatourism.in/plan/suggested-itineraries/itineraries): Suggested travel itineraries for Shillong, Garo Hills & Khasi Hills tours
- [Family Trips](https://meghalayatourism.in/experiences/travel-by-traveller-type/family-trips): Family-friendly trips to Umiam Lake, Cherrapunji & Dawki River

## Cultural Heritage & Handicrafts

- [Art & Handicrafts](https://meghalayatourism.in/explore/about-meghalaya/art-handicrafts): Khasi, Jaintia & Garo tribal art, handicrafts and traditional textiles

## Stories & Insights

- [On Cloud Nine: Meghalaya at 50](https://meghalayatourism.in/blogs/on-cloud-nine-meghalaya-at-50): Meghalaya's 50th statehood anniversary & matrilineal tribal culture

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://meghalayatourism.in/sitemap): Site navigation map of Meghalaya tourism destinations and attractions
